name: Shinya Izakaya - Boat Quay
description: Shinya Izakaya is a hidden gem in Singapore, bringing the charm of a traditional Japanese izakaya to life. Known for its delectable grilled skewers, fresh sashimi, and an extensive selection of sake, it offers a cozy and vibrant atmosphere perfect for casual gatherings or intimate dinners. Whether you're savoring authentic flavors or unwinding with friends, Shinya Izakaya promises an unforgettable dining experience. (Aug 2025)
